intentComment: Story 050 — redeploy fixed BatchNFTMinter, repoint SYA + BalancerPoolerV2, seed nudge pot from BPT, retire old contract
scriptDocComment: [story-050] Redeploys the fixed, minter-pinned BatchNFTMinter on mainnet, repoints its two real funders (SYA nudge address + BalancerPoolerV2 batchMinter), seeds its USDC nudge pot from the Balancer 50/50 phUSD/sUSDS BPT (proportional exit -> sUSDS->waUSDC->USDC seed + phUSD burn), and neutralizes the old exploited contract. Single owner-signed broadcast, PREVIEW_MODE-aware fork dry-run.

preview.note: vm.startPrank(OWNER) path; no on-chain state change; the agent runs THIS variant from workspace/, never lib/.

broadcast.note: vm.startBroadcast() path; --skip-simulation means the on-chain require/guard reverts are NOT caught by a pre-simulation; ledger-signed by OWNER 0xCad1...D0B6.

forgeTarget.auxContractInFile: SeedSwapHelper (deployed fresh per run; drives the Balancer V3 unlock callback for the sUSDS->waUSDC->USDC swap because an EOA cannot receive the unlock callback)

post.note: Rewrites BOTH the 'BatchNFTMinter' and 'NudgeBatchNFTMinter' keys to progress.batchMinter; throws if progress.batchMinter or the BatchNFTMinter key is missing.

chainIdSource: implicit via --rpc-url $RPC_MAINNET; NO in-script require(block.chainid == 1) guard exists
sender: 0xCad1a7864a108DBFF67F4b8af71fAB0C7A86D0B6 (OWNER constant; preview --sender and broadcast --ledger derive the same EOA)
